_note: PATHS: transcripts_dir and audit_output_dir are resolved against the repo root when relative, which is what the defaults below do. Keep them relative so this config works on any PM's machine; an absolute path encodes one person's filesystem and breaks for the next PM who clones the repo. A leading '~' is NOT expanded and is an error, not a fallback. Not yet read by anything shipping today, leave as-is: client_key, overlay.*, jira.api_token_ref, jira.progress.
_note_visibility: jira.visibility decides what the client can see, and it fails closed: only what is listed appears. mode 'config' needs no write access to Jira and is the default. mode 'label' uses the 'roadmap' label instead, and is only for a Jira board Anatta owns. include_parents is deliberately separate from lanes: lanes says which lane an issue lands in, include_parents says whether it is visible at all, so mapping an epic for placement never publishes all of its children.

visibility.note: Read-only in the client's Jira. Never label, edit, transition or comment.
